_readme: Bleakhold races for RaceForge. Every race clones its template race (models, sounds, class list) and joins the faction of faction_race (language, reputations, faction template, start zone). racials drops the template's racial skill lines and names the race's own racial spells; spells defines them (and the spells a server module casts or teaches) as Spell.dbc rows. id is the race id build gives (after the stock rows 1-21); realm_id is the race's id on the Bleakhold realm, whose own race patch (Patch-R.MPQ) put High Elf and Eredar in the stock slots 15 and 19: raceforge.py update works there. See README.md for every field.

start.comment: Northshire Valley, Elwynn Forest (the Human start)

death_knight_start.comment: Ebon Hold (the Blood Elf Death Knight start)

racials.comment: No Blood Elf racials (756: Arcane Torrent, Magic Resistance, Arcane Affinity). Wind Blessed instead; the glide, Walk on Air (100801 in the spellbook, aura 100800), is mod-bleakhold-ui's, which teaches it.

start.comment: Valley of Trials, Durotar (the Orc start)

death_knight_start.comment: Ebon Hold (the Draenei Death Knight start)

racials.comment: No Draenei racials (760: Gift of the Naaru, Heroic Presence, Shadow Resistance, Gemcutting). Elemental Insight and Read Ley Line instead.

spells.name: Wind Blessed
spells.description: Increases your melee, ranged and spell haste by $s1%.
spells.aura_description: Melee, ranged and spell haste increased by $s1%.
spells.comment: High Elf. Passive like Beast Slaying (attributes 0x50: ability, passive; endless duration 21, self). Aura 193 SPELL_AURA_MELEE_SLOW with +3 is Berserking's haste: melee, off-hand and ranged attack speed and cast speed, multiplying with other haste.

spells.name: Elemental Insight
spells.description: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by $s1%.
spells.aura_description: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by $s1%.
spells.comment: Eredar. Beast Slaying's row with another creature type: aura 168 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_DONE_VERSUS, +5%, creature type mask 8 (1 << (4 Elemental - 1)); melee, ranged and spell damage.

spells.name: Read Ley Line
spells.description: Read the ley lines beneath you, increasing your health and mana regeneration by $s1% for $d. Lasts 2 min when used while resting at an inn, in a city or at a campfire.
spells.aura_description: Health and mana regeneration increased by $s1%.
spells.comment: Eredar. Instant, 2 min cooldown, off the global cooldown, 30 s (duration 9); castable while sitting (0x08000000), so eating or drinking goes on. Aura 88 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALTH_REGEN_PERCENT and 110 SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_REGEN_PERCENT (mana), +100% each. Visual 4279 (Mana Tide's: a blue splash at the feet and glowing hands, then the mana swirl around the feet while it lasts; Nature Cast sound). mod-bleakhold makes it last 2 min when cast while resting.

spells.name: Walk on Air
spells.description: Glide through the air for $d, steering your descent. Does not gain altitude.
spells.aura_description: Gliding on the air. Turn to steer; you do not gain altitude.
spells.comment: The glide's aura (mod-bleakhold-ui, BleakholdUi.Glide.Spell): the module casts it when a glide starts (the spellbook racial 100801, /glide, the key binding or the Glide button), no race learns it. Its spell_dbc row is the module's own SQL (server_row; RaceForge checks it field for field and writes none); only enUS texts, as that row. Feather fall (aura 105) on the caster for 10 s (duration 1), instant, self; attributes 0x40010 (ability, no sheathe). visual is the glide's look, set here and in that row together: 63 is Slow Fall's (130): a light at the hands and a soft flash at the head when the glide starts, nothing that stays on the character. Others: 0 none (the Wind Shear gust of BleakholdUi.Glide.StartVisualKit alone), 12114 Guardian Spirit's golden wings for the whole glide, 12724 Cyclone Fall's whirl with a floating pose, 6768 Levitate's swirl at the feet, 7370 Magic Wings (the old: wings at the head). Ids 100800-100809 are the camping spells.

spells.name: Walk on Air
spells.description: Glide through the air for $100800d, steering your descent by turning. Use it while falling or jumping. Does not gain altitude.
spells.comment: The High Elf glide in the spellbook (mod-bleakhold-ui, BleakholdUi.Glide.CastSpell): the module teaches it at login to the races of BleakholdUi.Glide.Races (15, the High Elf on the realm) and puts it on a free action bar slot once; casting it starts the module's glide (its rules, its aura 100800), sharing the cooldown with /glide, the key binding and the Glide button. Usable only in the air (falling or jumping; on the ground the cast fails with "Cannot be used on the ground", which the addon words for the glide, and costs nothing). Instant, off the global cooldown (no startRecovery), 90 s cooldown (recoveryTime 90000: the action bar shows it; the module sends BleakholdUi.Glide.Cooldown when that differs), self (range 1), physical school (no spell school lockout). A dummy effect on the caster (effect 3, target 1) that the module's spell script handles; no visual of its own (the aura's is the glide's look). Icon 505 Spell_Magic_FeatherFall (Slow Fall's feather).

archives.comment: raceforge.py update merges the changed tables into the archive whose copy each player's client reads, with and without each launcher pack (Tools/MapForge's rules); own takes a table no patch holds.
